# Redstream Foundation

> Delhi-based non-profit coordinating verified emergency blood donations across the NCR by connecting patients in urgent need with nearby volunteer donors.

Redstream Foundation operates a 24/7 emergency blood-donor coordination platform. Patients (or their attendants) submit a verified request; coordinators verify hospital documents and notify a matched network of volunteer donors nearby. Donor identities and patient contacts are masked through Redstream's relay.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of the emergency blood coordination platform, live activity, and impact.
- [Request emergency blood](/request): Multi-step verified request flow for patients and attendants.
- [Become a donor](/donor): Information for volunteers who want to join the donor network.
- [Donor registration](/donor/register): Sign up with phone OTP, blood group, and locality.
- [Donor availability](/donor/availability): Set weekday/weekend availability and donation radius.
- [Donor dashboard](/donor/dashboard): Active status, impact metrics, and nearby requests.

## Optional

- [Operations console](/admin): Internal coordinator dashboard for verified staff.
